sovereign_country.strategic_role: 连接拉美市场的欧洲商贸桥梁、本地化仓配与数字游民签证

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Cryogenic Pumps

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Spain (unitary national jurisdiction; the Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada is incorporated under Spanish national law without sub-state company registers)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Continental European civil law tradition; no state-level corporate code divergence, though regional tax and fee rates may vary)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Spain–Mexico Reciprocal Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (APPRI)
Spain–United States Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (1990, as amended by the 2013 Protocol)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo, as amended by Ley 13/2023, de 24 de mayo; Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo, Reglamento de la Ley 10/2010; Real Decreto-ley 7/2021, de 27 de abril, establishing the central beneficial ownership register; Real Decreto 609/2023, de 11 de julio, creating the Registro Central de Titularidades Reales; Articles 4, 7, 17, and 23–29 of Ley 10/2010 govern identification, UBO declaration, and enhanced due diligence.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of foreign parent company incorporation certificate and current certificate of good standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent commercial registry or companies registry in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille followed by sworn Spanish translation; consular legalization only if the origin state is not a Hague Convention member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate resolution of the foreign parent company authorizing incorporation of the Spanish SL and appointment of the local incorporator or administrator
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors or shareholders' meeting of the foreign parent, certified by its legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille with attestation by origin-country notary and certified Spanish translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney (poder) granted by each ultimate beneficial owner or foreign shareholder to the Spanish notarial representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public notary in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, plus sworn translation into Spanish by an officially registered translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Ultimate beneficial ownership declaration statement with passport or national identity card copies of all UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign legal counsel or notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization for non-Hague states) with certified Spanish translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (Regulations (EU) 269/2014 and 2580/2001), the OFAC SDN List due to USD Swift Wire rails, and SEPBLAC advisories; politically exposed persons are identified per Article 2.1(k) Ley 10/2010 and subjected to enhanced due diligence under Article 17; no 10/2010 Act risk finding permits appointment of an administrator; compliance documentation must evidence the EDD report, the source-of-funds analysis for the capital contribution, and the reputational clearance of each foreign UBO.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Central Commercial Registry of Spain (Registro Mercantil Central – RMC) electronic portal for the negative name certificate (certificación negativa de denominación social): https://www.registradores.org and https://www.rmc.es
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be expressed in Spanish or in another co-official Spanish language (Catalan, Basque, or Galician) using Latin/Roman script; foreign-language terms must be transliterated to the standard Latin alphabet and phonetically adapted; the SL denomination must be followed by 'Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada' or 'S.L.'; the name must not be identical or phonetically/typographically similar to any pre-existing registered name, must not violate law, morality, or public order, and must not misrepresent the company type or a regulated activity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The negative name certificate is valid for 90 days from the date of issuance and cannot be extended; if incorporation has not occurred before expiry, a new online application must be submitted to the Registro Mercantil Central. If the RMC rejects a proposed name as identical or confusingly similar, the applicant may (i) file an administrative appeal (recurso de alzada) with the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública within one month from notification, (ii) resubmit alternative names in order of preference through the RMC electronic form, or (iii) where sensitive tokens require prior authorization, obtain the competent ministerial or supervisory authorization before reapplying. Judicial review of an administrative denial is available before the Sala de lo Contencioso-Administrativo de la Audiencia Nacional.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not acceptable as the sole commercial substance for an industrial manufacturer of LNG cryogenic pumps. A virtual office may serve only as an administrative correspondence point where the real management or primary operations are demonstrably located in Spain. For ISIC 2813, the municipal industrial activity license, environmental permits, AEAT tax inspections, and the Medium_Risk_Enhanced AML tier require a physical plant, warehouse, or operational establishment; banks and notaries will ordinarily refuse a purely virtual mailbox as the statutory seat under Article 9 of the Ley de Sociedades de Capital.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Elevated: quantified 55–70% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection within the first 24–36 months of operations, driven by mandatory industrial and environmental licensing, labor inspections, AEAT verification visits, and the enhanced due diligence profile triggered by foreign UBOs and the manufacturing scope.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Negative corporate name certificate (certificación negativa de denominación social) for 'S.L.' denomination
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Commercial Registry), Ministry of Justice

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial incorporation deed (escritura de constitución) of the Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Spanish notary in the province of the registered office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff schedule (arancel notarial); typically EUR 350–700 depending on capital, shareholders, and clauses

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate transaction tax quota (ITPAJD – operaciones societarias) at 1% of subscribed share capital
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Autonomous Community tax administration, collected through the notary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory rate of 1% under Royal Legislative Decree 1/1993 on a minimum capital of EUR 3,000 (EUR 30, rounded with regional adjustment)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial Registry filing and inscription fee (inscripción de la escritura de constitución)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Provincial Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil Provincial), Ministry of Justice
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official Mercantile Registry tariff (arancel del Registro Mercantil); approximately EUR 100–200

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Provisional Tax Identification Number (NIF provisional) application filing with AEAT on Form 036
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Free statutory procedure; electronic filing is mandatory

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT and UBO compliance pack: UBO piercing, PEP, UN, EU, and OFAC sanction screening, EDD report, and reputational verification
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for Spanish corporate law firms (approximately EUR 800–1,000); non-statutory fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legalization bundle for foreign shareholder documents: certified copies, Hague apostilles, and sworn Spanish translations (assumed 5-document package)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Origin-country competent legalization authority plus certified translator in Spain
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; apostille fees vary by origin country at USD 40–120 per document including sworn translation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank certificate of deposit for the statutory share capital (certificado de depósito bancario)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Spanish credit institution holding the blocking account

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Initial paid-in share capital – statutory minimum contributed to the SL treasury
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Company share capital account (verified by notary)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory minimum capital under Article 4 of the consolidated Ley de Sociedades de Capital (EUR 3,000, converted at approx. USD 1.09 per EUR); refundable capital contribution, not a government fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Gestoría administrative filing assistance: RMC name application, AEAT Form 036/037, and Social Security registration of administrators

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Spain Royal Legislative Decree 1/2010 of 2 July (Ley de Sociedades de Capital), Articles 20-33 (incorporation deed and capital), Article 66 (SL minimum capital), Articles 210-219 (registered office and bylaws), plus Mercantile Registry Regulations; regulated by the Spanish Commercial Code.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial (Provincial Commercial Registry) for registration; Registro Mercantil Central for the prior negative corporate name certificate; Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) for tax number issuance.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public incorporation deed (escritura pública de constitución) submitted for inscription in the Mercantile Registry (inscripción en el Registro Mercantil).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: General SL rule: minimum share capital is EUR 3,000 fully subscribed and paid in cash at or before execution of the deed, deposited in a Spanish credit entity which issues a blocked deposit certificate annexed to the deed. Alternative SLFS regime allows EUR 1 with statutory restricted distributions and mandatory 20% profit reserve until net worth reaches EUR 3,000.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the initial board of directors, acting under the Capital Companies Act, subscribes and allocates the share capital set out in the incorporation deed and acknowledges receipt of the bank deposit certificate evidencing full payment. RESOLVED, that the registered office be and is hereby established at the address stated in Article 1 of the bylaws within the territorial jurisdiction of the relevant Commercial Registry. RESOLVED, that [Name Surname] is appointed as sole administrator, with all corporate, administrative and legal representation powers attributed by law. RESOLVED, that the appointed officer is instructed to execute all filings with the Commercial Registry, tax agency and social security authorities, open operational bank accounts, and apply for all industrial and environmental permits.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain negative name certification for the proposed corporate name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central, Madrid; online application through the official electronic registry service.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the official name certificate request (solicitud de certificación negativa de denominación social) listing three alternative corporate names in order of preference. Pay the statutory fee. The Registry verifies that no existing company has a similar or identical name and issues a certificate valid for three months, which must be attached to the incorporation deed.
required_dossiers: List of three proposed corporate names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the request is rejected because the name coincides with or is confusingly similar to an existing entity, the Registry issues a negative certificate for the other alternate names; refile immediately with a newly differentiated name and obtain a fresh certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open a capital deposit account and obtain the bank certificate of paid-up capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish authorized credit entity (bank), branch in Spain.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the draft incorporation deed and the articles of association to the bank. Deposit at least EUR 3,000 (or EUR 1 in SLFS election) into an integration account. The bank issues a certificate of deposit (certificado de desembolso) confirming the account holder, the amount deposited, and the prohibition on withdrawing funds prior to commercial registration.
required_dossiers: Draft incorporation deed and corporate bylaws
Passport or NIE of each promoter
Beneficial ownership declaration and KYC forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires further AML documentation, provide source-of-funds evidence and notarized identity documents; alternatively select another authorized bank or, for low-capital SLFS formation, deposit EUR 1 and execute the statutory restriction acknowledgment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute the incorporation deed before a Spanish notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary in the notarial district of the registered office (Colegio Notarial de España).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit all preparatory documents to the notary. The notary reviews the legal capacity of the promoters, verifies the capital deposit certificate, confirms the legality of the bylaws, reads the deed, and receives signatures. The notary issues certified first copy of the public deed for registration.
required_dossiers: Founders' passports, NIEs and consent powers if represented
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises defects in the bylaws or capital proof, correct the clauses and re-sign an amended deed; if a founder cannot appear, execute a notarized power of attorney or arrange remote-notarial signature where permitted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain provisional tax identification number and liquidate stamp duty
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) and the autonomous community tax office (Oficina Liquidadora de Tributos).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form 036 to the AEAT within one month after deed execution to obtain the provisional NIF. Simultaneously submit Form 600 to self-assess the corporate transaction tax (ITP-AJD). Obtain the stamped and paid Model 600 because it is a prerequisite for Commercial Registry inscription.
required_dossiers: First notarial copy of the incorporation deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT queries the domicile or deed, present the original notarial copy and lease or ownership title of the registered office; if the tax administration recalculates AJD, pay the differential tax and obtain a corrected certified receipt before proceeding.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the company in the Provincial Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province where the registered office is located; electronic transmission from notary accepted (COPIA-e).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary normally transmits the certified deed electronically; alternatively the administrator files the first notarial copy, the paid Model 600, and ancillary certificates at the Registry. The Registrar examines the deed for legal compliance, orders any rectifications, and upon approval issues the registration certificate (inscripción) assigning the corporate data.
required_dossiers: First notarial copy of the public deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a temporary denial or defect list, cure each written defect within the legal reinstatement period by presenting a clarifying notarial instrument or supplementary documentation; the decision may be appealed to the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Finalize tax, social security, municipal and industrial registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS), and the municipal town hall.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration, submit amended Form 036 to convert the provisional NIF into the final NIF. Register the company as an employer with TGSS. File the municipal economic activity declaration (IAE) and, before launching operations, submit the local industrial activity commencement declaration and register the plant with the competent industrial registry.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If final NIF conversion is not automatic, appear at AEAT with the registration certificate; if TGSS rejects employer registration, correct the legal representative appointment deed and resubmit; for municipal IAE discrepancies, file an amended declaration with the local tax office.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Dirección General de Industria y de la Pequeña y Mediana Empresa, Ministerio de Industria, Comercio y Turismo, in coordination with the Consejería de Industria and Consejería de Medio Ambiente of the autonomous community where the manufacturing plant is located.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal industrial activity and opening license (licencia de actividad / apertura or declaración responsable de inicio de actividad), together with industrial establishment registration in the Registro Industrial.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITERD) and the competent autonomous community environmental authority.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B — environmental impact assessment screening required under Law 21/2013, Annex II for industrial machinery manufacturing involving cryogenic pump testing; a full Category A EIA may be required if on-site storage of LNG or other hazardous substances exceeds Seveso thresholds under Royal Decree 840/2015.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges must comply with Spanish water quality law and municipal sewer bylaws under R.D. 817/2015; VOC and air pollutant emissions must conform to Law 34/2007 and R.D. 117/2003; waste management must follow Law 7/2022; industrial refrigeration and fluorinated gases must comply with R.D. 115/2017; no untreated cryogenic liquids or nitrogen-rich purge streams may be released directly to the public sewer.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Mandatory fire-safety inspection and certificate from the local fire service; structural load and occupancy certification for the production building; low-voltage electrical and pressure-equipment inspections performed by an accredited control body (Organismo de Control Autorizado); occupational risk prevention plan and workplace health/safety compliance under R.D. 486/1997 and R.D. 39/1997; emergency response and gas-detection protocols required for cryogenic and LNG handling areas.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) and its official electronic portal at www.agenciatributaria.gob.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities procure a Spanish NIF by filing Form 036 or 037 with the AEAT, accompanied by identification documents, proof of legal representation, and corporate documents. VAT registration is required if taxable turnover exceeds one million euros annually.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Spain does not permit check-the-box elections; taxation occurs at the entity level. Hybrid mismatch provisions under the Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive (ATAD) govern certain cross-border structures.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Real-time reporting obligation under the SII system with mandatory digital invoicing stamps and API connectivity to the AEAT for immediate fiscal clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Eligibility for 0% VAT on exports of goods outside the European Union requires proof of actual export. Intra-Community supplies are subject to reverse charge. Offshore services may qualify for zero-rating under specific contractual and performance criteria.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Penalties for fraudulent zero-rating claims include fines equivalent to 100% of the evaded tax, surcharges, and potential imprisonment. Retrospective clawback applies upon audit if supporting documentation is insufficient or false.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain operates a fully convertible Euro regime with unrestricted access to both capital and current accounts. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are permitted without prior approval, subject only to standard corporate documentation, tax withholding at source, and AML compliance. No capital controls or exchange restrictions apply for EU-based entities or qualifying non-residents.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender of export proceeds to the central bank. Spanish exporters must file export declarations with the Customs Agency (Aduanas) within 15 days of shipment. Receipts may be collected in Spain or converted to EUR at market rates. Large export transactions trigger statistical reporting to the Bank of Spain via the Integrated Statistical Reporting System (SARI) for monitoring purposes only; no fixed conversion ratios apply.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Authorized Spanish Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) may facilitate cross-border payments under strict Banco de España oversight and EU Payment Services Directive (PSD2) compliance. Legal constraints include mandatory authorization, minimum capital requirements, ongoing prudential reporting, and restrictions on high-risk activities such as crypto-related services. MiCA compliance applies where relevant.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote digital KYC and onboarding is permitted for Spanish SL entities through certified platforms. Directors, authorized signatories, and beneficial owners must complete video identification or in-person interviews as required by Banco de España enhanced due diligence standards.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained source of funds for capital injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder resolutions, incorporation certificates, tax returns, bank statements, and independent source-of-wealth verification
Updated corporate filings, legal entity identifiers, shareholder agreements, and FATF-compliant source-of-wealth documentation

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent transaction patterns or red-flag jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Reconciliation reports, purpose letters, commercial invoices, and regulatory filings demonstrating legitimate business purpose

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital via SWIFT MT103 using purpose codes 'CAP' (capital contribution) or 'EQU' (equity injection). All transactions require supporting documentation including board resolutions, share purchase agreements, tax identification numbers, and beneficial ownership declarations. Correspondent banks perform standard verification; transactions are subject to Spanish AML monitoring and SARI statistical reporting where thresholds are exceeded.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements for LNG cryogenic pump exports utilize SWIFT MT103 for direct correspondent bank wires or issuance of Commercial Letters of Credit. Specify Incoterms (e.g., FCA, FOB, CIF) with commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, and export declarations. Clearing rails operate through global correspondent networks ensuring T+2 settlement cycles.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Legalisation of Annual Company Books (Legalización Electrónica de Libros)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after each financial year-end; by 30 April for calendar-year entities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to legalise may render accounting books inadmissible as evidence; registry may reject the annual accounts deposit and impose fines.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of Annual Accounts (Depósito de Cuentas Anuales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual accounts must be approved by shareholders within 6 months of financial year-end (by 30 June for calendar-year entities); deposit with the registry within 1 month of approval; final deadline 31 July for calendar-year entities.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registry sheet closure prevents filing of subsequent corporate documents; fines may reach up to EUR 300,000 for non-deposit; directors may be civilly liable.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporation Tax Return (Impuesto de Sociedades – Form 200)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Tax Administration (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria – AEAT)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 25 days following the 6-month period after the end of the tax period; by 25 July for calendar-year entities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 5% within 3 months, 10% within 6, 15% within 12, 20% after 12 months; tax penalties plus default interest accrue; no direct administrative strike-off but enforcement measures may escalate.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if the company exceeds at least two of the following for two consecutive years: total assets EUR 4,000,000; net annual turnover EUR 8,000,000; average workforce exceeding 50 employees. Also mandatory for listed entities, financial institutions, or entities meeting specific public-interest criteria.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (Plan General de Contabilidad) for individual financial statements; IFRS adopted by the EU for consolidated financial statements when applicable.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Spain does not impose a standalone annual UBO confirmation filing for an SL. Under Law 10/2010 and Royal Decree 609/2023, ultimate beneficial owner information must be continuously maintained; any share transfer or ownership change must be formalised by public deed and submitted to the Mercantile Registry for registration, with the updated UBO statement completed by the legal representative within 10 days of the notarised event.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors (Libro Registro de Consejeros or Administradores when applicable)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Juntas Generales y Administradores)

corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (indefinite carryforward under Art. 26 LIS; offset limited to 60% of taxable base for entities with net turnover below EUR 20 million and 25% for those above; minimum taxable base rules for large groups)
